scope: S4 complete 10k validation reused for repaired matched-compute control; calibration/test frozen
design_scope: Repaired stage145 baseline recipes. Full parent and continuation compute is charged; supervised selection envelope chooses lower validation NLL of complete parent and continuation. interval_scope: pointwise paired connected-chunk intervals conditional on the trained seeds and fixed common-support weights; seed SD reported separately
finite_MC_scope: 1%/0.1% FPR efficiency and tau branch counts reported; low selected backgrounds retain finite-MC intervals
resource_scope: per-task elapsed seconds are not allocation sums when sharing GPU; see campaign_accounting and matched_compute separately
